description: MISO (Midcontinent Independent System Operator, 15 US states and Manitoba) real-time generation fuel mix: MW and share for coal, natural gas, nuclear, wind, solar, battery storage, other and imports, total MW and the 5-minute interval; plus system load: latest 5-minute total load, today's hourly cleared load and the medium-term hourly load forecast. Related tools on this server, for a different need: energy_caiso_california_iso when you need CAISO grid today, from its Today's Outlook data: latest. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: energy_miso_midcontinent_iso
title: MISO real-time generation fuel mix: MW and share for coal
